title: Race Watch Party Guest Count Leaderboard
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:watchparty guest_count=*
| stats sum(guest_count) as total_value, avg(guest_count) as avg_value by venue
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks venue values by total and average guest count across race watch party events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `guest_count` values for each race watch party event and review total and average guest count by venue.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total guest count.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which venue shows the biggest guest count numbers in your race watch party data.
